scientific_integrity: All-length statements follow from an explicit unique-word decomposition and elementary coefficient extraction; finite direct enumeration is a check rather than a proof. The result concerns proper named words and one first-position swap only.
scientific_limitations: No claim of connectedness, Hamiltonicity where frozen states are absent, or correction of arbitrary prior results; priority remains subject to further bibliography.
title: Frozen proper words under star transpositions: a composition census and a sharp balanced threshold
